title: Arcane Index Reference: Integrations
summary: Pair Arcane Index with Grimoire, Wiki, missions, scans, and optional bridge catalogs.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: Arcane Index reads Arcana Core, mirrors guide-book records, links to Grimoire archives, and can stay useful without JEI.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use Index for facts, Grimoire for tone and warnings, Wiki for manuals, Lens for scan context, and MissionCore for route objectives.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: If a live provider is absent, trust static bridge records and verify exact recipes or states in the source addon before spending rare items.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
